title: Timing is Everything
description: Find the earliest time to press the button so a falling capsule passes through every spinning disc's slot.
writeup:
## Approach

Each disc `i` (1-indexed) has `n` positions and starts at position `p` at time 0. When you press the button at time `t`, the capsule reaches disc `i` at time `t + i`, at which point the disc is at position `(p + t + i) % n`. For the capsule to pass through, this must equal 0 for every disc simultaneously.

This is a system of modular congruences — exactly the shape of the **Chinese Remainder Theorem**. Rather than a full CRT implementation, a simpler iterative sieve works cleanly:

1. Start with `t = 0`, step size `1`.
2. For each disc in order, advance `t` in steps until that disc's condition is satisfied.
3. Once a disc is satisfied, multiply the step size by that disc's period — this preserves all previously satisfied conditions while stepping forward.

This works because the disc sizes in AoC inputs are mutually coprime, so `lcm = product`.

## Part 1

Parse the discs and run the sieve. The answer is typically found within a few hundred thousand iterations at most.

## Part 2

Append one extra disc: 11 positions starting at 0, placed one level below the existing discs. The sieve runs identically — only the input changes.
